title: Global Apheresis Market to Reach USD 4.41 Billion by 2031, Driven by Plasma-Based Therapies and Automated Technologies
author: Researchandmarkets.Com
description: The global apheresis market is projected to grow from USD 3.02 billion in 2026 to USD 4.41 billion by 2031, with a CAGR of 7.9%. Growth is driven by rising prevalence of autoimmune and neurological diseases, increased demand for plasma-derived therapies, and technological advances in automated systems. Disposables lead the product segment while plasmapheresis dominates procedures. North America holds the largest regional market share. Key challenges include high procedural costs and limited adoption in emerging markets.
